title: Data Analyst
description:
Data & Business AnalystSalary: £30,000 - £35,000

37 hours per week

Applications close Monday


Are you analytically minded, confident working with data and Excel, and looking for a role where your analysis can directly influence business decisions? An excellent opportunity has arisen for a Business & Data Analyst within my market-leading client's team, supporting its Regulatory Affairs and Transportation Services teams.
This is a varied analytical role combining data analysis, financial and economic assessment, business modelling and regulatory support. You'll work with complex information to help inform decision-making, improve operational performance and support the organisation in meeting its regulatory requirements.
What you'll be doing

  • Producing financial, economic and analytical assessments to support business requirements.
  • Analysing data and using computer modelling to support business activities.
  • Supporting regulatory and operational projects across the organisation.
  • Helping identify and manage regulatory risk.
  • Supporting business change through collaboration with teams across the organisation.
  • Developing knowledge of the Northern Ireland regulatory environment and gas market.
  • Building effective relationships with key external stakeholders, including regulators, suppliers and other network operators.

What we're looking forWe're looking for someone who enjoys working with data and numbers, can interpret information accurately and is comfortable turning analysis into meaningful business insight.
You'll need:

  • A degree in a numerate, business or legal-related discipline, or 3 A-levels/equivalent with at least one year's relevant business experience.
  • Experience using analytical techniques and computer modelling within a business environment.
  • Excellent Microsoft Excel and broader Microsoft Office skills.
  • Strong numerical and analytical ability.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • The ability to work independently and deliver within tight timescales.

Experience within a regulated environment, such as energy, utilities, financial services, telecoms, transport or the public sector, would be advantageous but isn't essential. Knowledge of database or data-management tools such as Access or SQL would also be beneficial.
Why apply?This is a great opportunity for someone looking to develop their career in business analysis, data and regulation within an established Northern Ireland organisation.
Salary: £30,000 - £35,000Applications close Monday.
